gamerule.morph.kills_to_unlock.descripti: How many of a mob you must kill before you can morph into it. Other looks of a mob you already know unlock on one kill.
gamerule.morph.keep_morphs_on_death.desc: When off, dying forgets every unlocked morph, starred morph and kill count.
gamerule.morph.morph_on_unlock.descripti: Turn into a mob as soon as you unlock it.
gamerule.morph.allow_flight.description: When off, flying mobs like parrots and blazes only flutter down slowly.
gamerule.morph.monster_behavior.descript: Disguise: like the mob you look like. Monsters only: only monster bodies are safe. Off: morphing changes nothing.
